verified_at.description: Stored complete-witness verification and logical acceptance time, after all required evidence and binding checks; not physical DB commit, ACK, reward approval or payout confirmation. Null when no eligible witness is saved.

Request.description:
Validate the six-field canonical R, canonical URL including query, exact canonical body UTF-8 SHA-256 and request_digest. Send saved body bytes without JSON re-encoding.  Request input, R and JSON normalization

`sample-terms` v3 prepares a request using a closed `request_input` object with `method`, `url`, `body`. All three are required. method is exactly GET/POST. url is the user-supplied URL processed by the existing allowed canonical-URL policy. GET body is JSON null; POST body is the original JSON-text string. Keeping the input as text allows duplicate/number/Unicode validation before lossy generic object parsing. This input is not a dispatchable R and must not bypass preparation.

Return the authoritative R, its request_digest and the normalized selectable purchase terms with their corresponding v3 digests. Repeated verification may submit the same canonical body as request_input; canonical equality preserves R. After preparation, dispatch/import/registration/Claim/journal use and validate R, not the original textarea or an independently regenerated object.

R has exactly these six required fields:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "ln_church.paid_service_request.v2",
  "method": "POST",
  "url": "https://example.com/paid",
  "content_type": "application/json",
  "body": "{\"query\":\"example\"}",
  "body_sha256": "<64 lowercase hex digits, no 0x prefix>"
}
```

- GET: content_type/body/body_sha256 are null; no body, Content-Type or Content-Length on the target request.
- POST: content_type is exactly application/json, body is canonical JSON text, and body_sha256 hashes exactly its UTF-8 bytes. Send these same bytes with actual Content-Length; no BOM, Content-Encoding or appended newline. body is not serialized/requoted once more for target transmission.
- Both: uppercase method, fixed canonical URL including query; no per-execution URL/query rewriting or redirect. Missing/unknown fields and digest mismatch are invalid. An endpoint display alias, if retained by a DTO, must be derived from R.url and validated equal; it is not another request authority.

| JSON input rule | Fixed meaning |
|---|---|
| Values | object, array, string, number, true, false, null are allowed; empty/whitespace-only text is not JSON |
| Size | original input text and canonical output each <=16,384 UTF-8 bytes, inclusive; the full API envelope also must fit existing65,536 bytes |
| Depth | maximum simultaneously nested object/array containers64; root container depth1, root scalar0 |
| Duplicates | compare decoded member names; a and \\u0061 are duplicates |
| Unicode | valid UTF-8, no initial BOM, no unpaired surrogates; preserve decoded Unicode without normalization |
| Object keys | all JSON keys including __proto__/constructor/prototype retain ordinary data meaning; no prototype mutation or silent dropping |
| Ordering / serialization | RFC8785 JCS, including UTF-16 code-unit key order and ECMAScript binary64 number serialization |
| LN integer restriction | an exactly integral input decimal value, including exponent spelling, must be within ±9007199254740991; a parsed binary64 integer must also stay in that range. Validate without first rounding away an out-of-range source integer |
| Non-integral numbers | convert to finite binary64 and JCS output; rounding and -0→0 follow that output and are visible in preview. Reject overflow/nonfinite; represent higher precision as a JSON string |

POST body `"null"` contains four target bytes and is not GET body null. POST body containing the two quotes of a JSON empty string is valid. Quotes/backslashes needed by the enclosing LN API JSON are transport escaping and are not additional target body bytes.

Reject unsafe or malformed input before contacting the target or asking for a signature. Do not silently fix input, discard duplicate keys, replace secrets with redaction text, or use Python code-point sorting as a substitute for UTF-16 JCS order. The [fixture](../contracts/v18-5-paid-service-trial-contract-v3.json) contains language-neutral body/digest examples, not implementation test PASS claims.
